description: Create a book club voting spreadsheet at /home/ga/Documents/Spreadsheets/BookClubVote.xlsx. The spreadsheet should have 5 book candidates (titles and authors) in columns A and B. Add 8 member rating columns (C-J) with headers like 'Member 1', 'Member 2', etc. In column K, create AVERAGE formulas to calculate the average rating for each book across all 8 members. Make the header row bold. The 5 books are: 'The Midnight Library' by Matt Haig, 'Lessons in Chemistry' by Bonnie Garmus, 'Tomorrow, and Tomorrow, and Tomorrow' by Gabrielle Zevin, 'The Lincoln Highway' by Amor Towles, and 'Demon Copperhead' by Barbara Kingsolver. Save the spreadsheet (Ctrl+S).
